questions.stem: You are required to animate a company logo. The logo depicts a planet orbiting the sun.

parts.label: a
parts.text: State TWO animation file formats suitable for this project.
parts.answer: GIF and MP4 are suitable; SWF is also acceptable.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Describe the steps of cel animation and ONE advantage of using it.
parts.answer: Draw each frame, capture the frames in sequence, then play them back; it gives direct artistic control.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Differentiate 2-D and 2.5-D animation with ONE example for each.
parts.answer: 2-D uses flat drawings such as a cartoon; 2.5-D adds depth to flat artwork, such as parallax layers in a game.

questions.stem: A museum wants a website that presents its collection and lets visitors explore related exhibits.

parts.label: a
parts.text: State TWO differences between linear and non-linear navigation.
parts.answer: Linear follows a fixed sequence; non-linear lets users choose their own path.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Describe TWO roles of hyperlinks in the website.
parts.answer: They connect related exhibits and let users move between pages.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Explain how streaming and compression affect multimedia delivery on the web.
parts.answer: Compression reduces file size for faster transfer; streaming lets audio or video play while it downloads.

questions.stem: A shopping complex requires a kiosk that gives customers location and retailer information.

parts.label: a
parts.text: State TWO important project team roles for completing the kiosk.
parts.answer: A project manager and an interface designer are important roles.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Design a low-fidelity prototype for a pre-school courseware home page. The page must show topic menus, the course title and the school logo.
parts.answer: A simple sketch with a title, logo and large topic buttons is sufficient at low fidelity.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Discuss TWO factors that lead to the wide use of mobile devices in games and shopping applications.
parts.answer: Portability and constant connectivity make mobile devices convenient for games and shopping.

questions.stem: Text is an essential element in a multimedia project. Its shape, size, design, colour, arrangement and linking all affect the message.

parts.label: a
parts.text: State TWO reasons sans serif is mostly used for screen display and serif is used for printed material.
parts.answer: Sans serif is cleaner at screen sizes; serif aids reading in print.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Describe TWO roles of hypertext in multimedia.
parts.answer: It links related content and supports non-linear navigation.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Explain how text can have a massive impact on an informative multimedia project in the link and HTML context.
parts.answer: Clear headings and links guide users through HTML pages and make the information easier to scan and follow.
